Our Love Story

Wedding Day Timeline

Wedding Ceremony

10:30 AM - 12:00 PM

Béthanie Chapel - The Academy's Landmark Heritage Campus

Join us for our wedding ceremony under the love of God. Please arrive 15 minutes early for seating.

Chinese Tea Ceremony

2:00 PM - 5:00 PM

Harbour Grand Hong Kong, North Point

Traditional Chinese tea ceremony to honor our families and receive blessings from our elders. Private Event, close family only.

Cocktail Hour

5:30 PM - 8:00 PM

Marina Suite, Aberdeen Marina Club

Enjoy cocktails, hors d'oeuvres, and mingling while we take photos.

Reception Dinner

8:00 PM - 11:00 PM

Grand Ballroom, Aberdeen Marina Club

Traditional Chinese bouqet, free flow drinks. Please note your dietary preferences in your RSVP.

Getting There

Shuttle Service

Complimentary shuttle service available:

  • Lam Tin MTR Station → Béthanie Chapel:
  • Departure at 9:45 AM
  • Admiralty MTR Station → Béthanie Chapel:
  • Departure at 10:00 AM
  • Aberdeen Marina Club → Admiralty MTR Station:
  • Departure at 10:30 PM, 11:00 PM

Public Transport

To Aberdeen Marina Club

The closest Public Transport station is Wong Shuk Hang Station (South Island Line) which is about 10 minutes away from Aberdeen Marina Club.

To Béthanie Chapel

Guests can drop off at 'Pok Fu Lam Reservoir Road' bus station.

Bus routes: Citybus 4, 4X, 7, 37B, 40, 40M, 90B, 91, 970, 970X, 973.

Parking Information

  • Complimentary Self-parking available at Aberdeen Marina Club only
  • Please let us know your car plate number in advance
  • Béthanie Chapel has limited parking spaces, parking is not available for guests.
